text_block_list.text:
The spring Classics. We held back on the 
intense training for them. Even so—

The Nippon Derby. Unable to resist the 
once-in-a-lifetime temptation, the outcome 
was—

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Manhattan Cafe conquers the Derby!! The 
immortal skyscraper stands tall and proud 
here today!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
However, will she be all right?! Utterly 
exhausted, her footing looks unsteady...! 
Even so, she has answered the 
long-cherished dream of all who believed 
in her—!!

She looked painfully haggard. Even so, 
Manhattan Cafe came through in the end.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Good grief, even though I told you not to 
chase the win. Letting it go in one ear 
and out the other—what impressive 
permeability.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Trainer, you must make up for that 
reckless display with your treatment. 
Administer the nutritional supplements in 
this order: 3a, 8b, and 6d_2.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"After that, absolute bed rest for three 
days. Well, as long as you moderate your 
training like you said, you should pull 
through just fine."

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
Haha, if you were going to apologize, you 
should have just stopped yourself from the 
start.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
"Now that you've run, hold your head high. 
...After all, you obtained what you 
desired, didn't you?"

"Thanks to some devoted aftercare, it 
looks like we've managed to secure the 
best possible outcome while keeping our 
hopes alive for the autumn season..."
